messages.content: Return only JavaScript defining class LRUCache. constructor(capacity) receives a nonnegative integer. get(key) returns the stored value or -1 when missing and makes an existing key most recently used. put(key,value) inserts or updates, makes the key most recent and evicts the least recent when over capacity. Zero capacity retains nothing. Support string and numeric keys, falsy values and updates without extra eviction. Operations must be O(1) average. No external packages.
